scope_note: A new section in the coverage-completion round the repository owner authorised on 2026-09-14 (audits/coverage/2026-09-14/STUDY-GUIDE-COVERAGE-COMPLETION-PLAN.json); no earlier audit binds it. All five planned records state less than, or other than, the official text and were replaced before freezing: FED-PSE-QUANTITY (pins a 9-gram per-purchaser 30-day retail limit to 21 CFR 1314.20, which contains only the 3.6 g calendar-day and 7.5 g mobile-vendor limits; 9 g is the purchaser prohibition in 21 U.S.C. 844(a)) by FED-SLCP-SALES-QUANTITY-LIMITS; FED-PSE-LOG-ID and FED-PSE-SELF-CERT (DEA web guidance recorded as primary law, with hedged wording the regulations do not use) by FED-SLCP-LOGBOOK-AND-IDENTIFICATION and FED-SLCP-TRAINING-AND-SELF-CERTIFICATION; MA-EXCEPTED-CS-SALE (omits that an M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 4 exception must be made by regulation) by MA-CS-EXCEPTED-PREPARATIONS; and MA-HYPODERMIC-SALE (silent on chapter 208 of the Acts of 2018, s. 32I(d) and c. 111, s. 25K) by MA-HYPODERMIC-SALE-TERMS, with the Board's advisory as MA-BOP-HYPODERMIC-SALE-ADVISORY. Added for in-scope law no record carried: FED-SLCP-COVERAGE-AND-STATE-LAW, FED-SLCP-PLACEMENT-PACKAGING-DELIVERY, FED-SLCP-LOSS-REPORTING, FED-CS-NONPRESCRIPTION-DISPENSING, and MA-SLCP-NO-ADDED-STATE-REQUIREMENTS, which records a dated search result (as of 2026-09-16 none of M.G.L. c. 94C, 247 CMR or 105 CMR 700.000 addresses these products or adds to the federal requirements) rather than a rule of law. Existing accurate rules cited for part only: FED-CS-RECORDS-2Y, MA-EPRESCRIBE-STATUTORY-EXCEPTIONS and MA-CS-RECORDS-STATE-DUTY. Scope gate: every signal declined. Two are records replaced above (MA-EXCEPTED-CS-SALE, MA-HYPODERMIC-SALE); the rest belong to schedule placement (FED-OPIATE-DEFINITION, MA-SCHEDULE-VI, MA-SCHEDULES-FEDERAL-INCORPORATION), administration (MA-ADMIN-ELIGIBLE-LIST-BASES, MA-ADMINISTER-STATUTORY-ROUTES), refills (MA-CS-REFILL-AUTHORIZATION), controlled-substance theft and loss (MA-THEFT-LOSS-POLICE-COPIES), the general readily-retrievable definition, which the section does not rely on (FED-READILY-RETRIEVABLE), or prescription dispensing (MA-EMERGENCY-SITUATION-EXCEPTION, MA-ORAL-CS-FOLLOWUP-TIMING, MA-ORAL-FOLLOWUP-DEPARTMENT-GUIDANCE, MA-RX-EMERGENCY-ORAL-CII). Practice links: MA-Q-0107, MA-Q-0108, MA-Q-0114 and MA-Q-0121; MA-Q-0002, MA-Q-0005 and MA-Q-0404 are not released.
